faqs.q: Sec. 98-37. - Tax in lieu of other taxes, etc.
faqs.a:
The tax provided in this article shall be in lieu of all other occupation taxes or
               taxes on the privilege of doing business in the city on any provider subject to the
               provisions of this article and in addition shall be in lieu of any free service furnished
               the city by any said provider.
(Code 1981, § 31-22; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
